verdict.rationale: Statsig's docs say it splits users into control and test groups, serves each a different variant, and reports metric lifts with confidence intervals. Experiments are created and configured in the console, and a community commenter praised its statistical rigor. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of designating goal/primary metrics per experiment, and detail on significance thresholds or p-value reporting in the results view.

support.subject: As a product-manager, I can run A/B experiments with goal metrics and statistical significance reported on the results

citations.quote: Statsig splits users into a control group and one or more test groups, serves each group a different variant, and reports metric lifts with confidence intervals.
Create a new experiment in the Statsig console, including device-level, custom ID, and isolated experiments, then configure it on the Setup tab before you start it.
Their team was impressed by how Statsig balanced dev velocity and statistical rigor
